caption: The drawing depicts a brown ceramic pitcher with a detailed and textured surface. The body of the pitcher is decorated with raised designs featuring hanging game animals, such as rabbits and birds, as well as foliage motifs. The handle of the pitcher is sculpted to resemble an animal, possibly a dog, which is integrated into the overall form of the object. The rim of the pitcher is scalloped and uneven, and the spout is pronounced. The colors used in the drawing range from various shades of brown to subtle hints of green and ochre, highlighting the texture and depth of the ceramic material. The background is plain and light, emphasizing the pitcher as the central subject of the composition.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
